biography:
As a Principal Program and Product Manager at Microsoft, I lead multiple high visibility projects for large enterprises, from platform concept definition through execution and deployment. With over 14 years of experience in the tech industry, I have developed strong skills in customer relationship management, technical leadership, and mentoring. I am passionate about delivering innovative solutions that enhance the performance, efficiency, and scalability of Microsoft's data centers and AI capabilities.

My current responsibilities include leading high impact projects that deliver telemetry visibility, power efficiency, and optimizations on GPU/server deployments across the Microsoft data center fleet. These projects directly contribute to Microsoft's expansion of AI capabilities and its partnership with OpenAI. I also collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across organizational boundaries, ensuring alignment of goals, expectations, and deliverables. I have been recognized consistently by top management for my leadership, communication, and creative problem-solving abilities.
